title: Sign correction for the nonreducible n-ary classification
outcome: The literal printed (-1)^i formula in Conjecture5.3 cannot represent the idempotent nonreducible strictly coordinate-monotone ternary heap x-y+z. All hypotheses and nonreducibility are proved.
novelty: Literal printed-sign correction using the source’s own known heap example. No claim to refute the intended formula with (-1)^(i+1) or solve its classification problem; no worldwide novelty claim.
